description: This Java source file defines the ModelTree class and its nested classes, modeling a read-only data structure representing a tree widget component in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for rendering tree nodes, handling node actions, conditions, and associated screen elements, and manages internal data like node maps and configuration attributes.

classes.name: ModelTree
classes.description: Represents a read-only model of a tree widget, including configuration attributes, node map, and rendering logic.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode
classes.description: Models a tree node, including its actions, conditions, display elements, and child nodes.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode.Label
classes.description: Models a label element within a tree node, with rendering and expansion capabilities.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode.Image
classes.description: Models an image element within a tree node, with rendering capabilities.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode.Link
classes.description: Models a hyperlink element within a tree node, supporting parameters, rendering, and target attributes.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelSubNode
classes.description: Models a sub-node configuration within a tree node, including actions and node name expansion.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for the ModelTree or ModelNode.

methods.name: getBoundaryCommentName
methods.description: Returns a boundary comment name for the tree based on location and name.

methods.name: getDefaultEntityName
methods.description: Returns the default entity name for the tree.

methods.name: getDefaultPkName
methods.description: Returns the primary key name for the default entity based on context.

methods.name: getExpandCollapseRequest
methods.description: Constructs the expand/collapse request string based on context and request parameters.

methods.name: getOpenDepth
methods.description: Returns the configured open depth for the tree.

methods.name: getPostTrailOpenDepth
methods.description: Returns the post-trail open depth configuration.

methods.name: getRenderStyle
methods.description: Returns the default render style for the tree.

methods.name: getRootNodeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the root node.

methods.name: getTrailName
methods.description: Returns the trail name expanded from context.

methods.name: getWrapStyle
methods.description: Returns the wrap style expanded from context.

methods.name: renderTreeString
methods.description: Renders the entire tree structure as a string using the provided renderer and context.

methods.name: getDefaultWrapStyleExdr
methods.description: Returns the default wrap style expander.

methods.name: getForceChildCheck
methods.description: Returns whether force child check is enabled.

methods.name: getNodeMap
methods.description: Returns the map of node names to ModelNode objects.
